objective: Compare default, v1 and v2 candidate selection through the SGLang startup wrapper with existing v1 persistence; separate selection quality from public eager/graph execution costs.
source_commit_rule: Execute the clean commit containing this plan; record that exact commit in the runtime manifest. Python harness/wrapper hashes must equal the audited baseline above.

protocol.order: seeded shuffle, rotate arm order across trials; cold then warm per arm; cases run sequentially
protocol.tactics: isolated per case/trial/arm; cold and warm share only that tactic cache
protocol.compilation_caches: shared within this batch; initial module setup occurs outside startup timing

acceptance: All worker exits and coordinator validation succeed.
Numerical eager and changed-input/restored-input CUDA Graph replay checks pass.
Cold v1/v2 enter actual profiling; v2 successfully profiles default -1 at the runtime bucket; v1 does not profile -1.
Default, warm and post-startup paths never profile.
Tuned natural winners are true bare/capture cache hits and survive fresh-process warm reuse with unchanged cache hashes.
Runtime tactic ordinals are eligible; forced-memory sweep confirms each intended selection.
Source, runtime/image, device, timer and measurement identities match throughout the batch.
All independent timings meet warmup/calibration protocol and raw-normalized consistency checks.
analysis_rules: Use three paired trial ratios of worker medians; 15 samples within a worker are repeated observations, not 15 independent trials.
Keep shapes, cold/warm phases and eager/replay modes separate.
Compare natural v2/v1/default timings, startup instrumentation costs, winner frequencies and raw trial dispersion.
Group startup profiles by actual runtime input M; compare profile minima with selected candidates and independent same-worker forced-memory rankings.

Forced-memory selected-tactic diagnostic ratios use the forced measurement of that tactic divided by the best forced candidate under the same execution mode; do not mix natural file-loaded cost into that ranking.
Retain failures, retries, non-winning defaults, neutral results and regressions; no silent exclusions.
Investigate differences before claiming improvement; n=3 is exploratory and does not establish significance or model-serving performance.
limitations: Single GPU, one dense FP8 cuBLAS operation with unit dequantization scales and reused/hot buffers; no full model, TP/EP, managed-store or MegaMoE comparison.
Tactic ordinals are shape-specific heuristic positions, not stable kernel identifiers; -1 may execute the same device algorithm as ordinal0.
The optional sweep forces memory-cache hits, including warm workers; natural warm lookup may use loaded-file configs. It is a diagnostic rather than an exact warm-path optimality oracle.
M144 tunes and serves144 and normalizes to bucket256; this batch does not test tuning256 then serving144.
Wall and event spans can include host submission gaps. Startup timing is instrumented wrapper tuning/warmup, not full server startup.
500ms warmup and before/after clock snapshots do not prove stable clocks; no global clock settings changed.

publication.retain: plan, launcher, image/runtime provenance, exact commands, raw coordinator and per-worker JSON/logs/caches, analysis JSON and analysis script; narrative remains in the existing living Markdown record
